reasons.plausibility: Drawing on well-established oxide-dispersion strengthening concepts and known benefits of oxide layers for corrosion/oxidation resistance, this mechanism appears scientifically sound though it relies on precise process control.
reasons.testability: A clear experiment comparing partially oxidized samples with inert-processed controls, coupled with measurements of strength and corrosion/oxidation, provides a decisive way to falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct strategy for simultaneously improving multiple properties in lightweight HEAs, providing a practical research direction for aerospace and related applications.
